page.layout: One column of running text; in the right margin, short variant notes beside lines 2, 5 and 6. Above the text, the running head and a centred title "Partitio." Below the text, a heading "ARGVMENTVM." followed by a short paragraph and a paragraph of text. No notes below the text, catchword or signature.

main_text.head: Partitio.
main_text.p: Atq; aut redeat.) Enunciatio 1. Natus a-pud hostes, natus tum demum videtur, cùm in civitatem affertur.
Nihil refert an exiure.) Sequitur 2. Qui quocumque tempore nascitur, institu-tus reperitur, utrum ad ius[?] antiquum, an ad legem Velleam referatur, nihil interest.
main_text.head: ARGVMENTVM.
main_text.p: Verba Ceruidianæ formulæ quam vis de nepote cogitata sint, in pronepote tamen, qui eius in locum succes-sit, valent.

Forsitan addubitet quis, {*}an istis casibus, si nepos post testamentum nascatur vivo patre suo, deinde ex eo concipiatur, isque {*}vivomor- patre, dein de avo, nascatur: an non potuerit hæres institui, qua pater ipsius non recte institutus es-set,

page.notes: The "«" marks in the right margin are printed bracket marks beside each line of text, not words. The note at line 2 reads "in", the note at line 5 reads "mor-", and the note at line 6 reads "two"; the reference marks "*" in the text are printed beside "an" and "vivo" (line 5); I have marked them as "{*}" and linked the notes to them. Doubtful: "ad ius" on line 2 appears as "adíus" with a stray accent; "ius" is marked [?]. The text of line 2 is slightly blurred. Stains and show-through are ignored.
